answer: The ember counter is kept in anchor and ridge makes public each reset. An adversary hence has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 46 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 46 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Each duplicate costs another 121 dollars in locked collateral and another 5 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
